'''2010 Worlds Day 2 James Barnes DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet Name field '''JAMES BARONIS'''; Username jcb213 matches Light sheet James Barnes.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Username:''' jcb213
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
